translations.web: You shall return and obey Yahweh’s voice, and do all his commandments which I command you today.
translations.bsb: And you will again obey the voice of the LORD and follow all His commandments I am giving you today.
translations.kjv: And thou shalt return and obey the voice of the LORD, and do all his commandments which I command thee this day.
translations.asv: And thou shalt return and obey the voice of Jehovah, and do all his commandments which I command thee this day.
